mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id, p.payment_type, p.amount, p.status, p.method, p.paid_at, p.created_at, p.fair_id, p.business_id, p.payer_user_id, p.reservation_id, p.application_id FROM payment p LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id WHERE p.fair_id = #{fairId} AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' AND p.payment_type IN ('RESERVATION_DEPOSIT', 'VENDOR_FEE') AND r.refund_id IS NULL
